question: On the ClimaTrol 24 controller, should I connect my alarm system to the NO or the NC terminal of the alarm relay?
facts: The alarm relay has three terminals: NO, C (common) and NC
Use NC for an alarm system that triggers when current to its input is cut off
Use NO for an alarm system that triggers when current is supplied to its input
traps: Answering for the ClimaTrol 22, whose relay is labelled differently
